'''Plastisynth''' was a composite material. It was notably used by the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] [[Forger (profession)/Legends|counterfeiters]], who used it to make forged [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] tokens.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin">''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]''</ref>
